hero.caption: Description: Plaque honouring four South African servicemen killed during Operation Savannah, Voortrekker Monument, Pretoria. 2014. Remark: Three of the deceased were national servicemen who crewed Eland Mk7 armoured cars. The fourth was a spotter pilot in the SAAF.
hero.alt: Description: Plaque honouring four South African servicemen killed during Operation Savannah, Voortrekker Monument, Pretoria. 2014. Remark: Three of the deceased were national servicemen who crewed Eland Mk7 armoured cars. The fourth was a spotter pilot in the SAAF.
